title: Closest Person-to-Cake Gap on a Line
description_html:
Given an array where 0 = empty spot, 1 = person, 2 = cake. The distance between a person and a cake is the number of empty spots between them — i.e. |i - j| - 1, not the index difference.

Return the shortest distance between any person and any cake.

Examples

[1, 0, 2] -> 1     # gap of 1 empty spot
[1, 1, 2] -> 0     # adjacent, 0 empty between

Follow-up

Each person goes for the closest cake. Given a person's index, return which cake index they end up eating. (No need to handle conflicts or ties.)

1D person/cake nearest — the line companion of #10059 / #10060. See Notes.
